scope: Current repository facts for diagrams 08/09/10; read-only inspection, no production/model/collector invocation.

facts.statement: Source default AI_AGENT_BACKEND is legacy (Go internal bounded model loop). Only explicitly configured agentscope backend invokes the independent Python AgentScope runtime; diagrams 08 and expanded AI lane in 09 describe that configurable branch, not inferred live deployment.

Go calls independent Python AgentScope with HTTP/1.1 over private runner Unix socket POST /v1/run. Runner callbacks use separate Go Unix socket POST /v1/callback/{run_id}. Go orchestration and tool gateway are roles within the same Go process, not two independently deployed services.

Both sides verify real process UID using SO_PEERCRED. Public run_id differs from per-run random >=192-bit capability. Capability stays in control connection/memory, is not model-visible, and is revoked on cancellation/completion. Socket dirs have separate owners 10001/10002, group10003 mode2750 and consumer read-only mounts.

Run request contains phase/model/system_prompt/messages/tools/budget and optional checkpoint. Ordinary diagnosis sends user problem plus redacted summary and pseudonymized bounded tool observations. Runner uses server-side configured HTTPS model endpoint/key; no RAW profile, storage URLs, cookies, or tool/executor credentials are model observations. Explicit source repair consent separately permits enrolled source excerpts.

Before each actual provider attempt Go reserves a model round. Tool callback carries type/round/call_id/name/arguments; Go independently validates name/schema/authorization/source/current attempt/lease/budget. Finish validates required hotspot/quality/comparison tools and exact evidence reference/path/value/unit; hypotheses remain bounded interpretations. Go-accepted result, rather than arbitrary model body, is returned and committed.

PostgreSQL holds only bounded visible checkpoints, counters, accepted JSON and tool receipts, not hidden chain of thought or capability. Pending receipt is committed before action; exact completed call replays can reuse response. Ambiguous pending tool state fails recovery rather than blindly repeating unknown external effects. New sessions retain cumulative budgets.

Each account can keep 10 nonterminal investigations, including awaiting confirmation. Same key/same canonical input replays existing record; success/failed/canceled release capacity. Source limit is current 10, independent diagnosis and repair quotas were not raised.

POST /investigations binds goal, authorized agent/target identity, consent, idempotency and optional code/telemetry binding. Planner lists actual collectors and proposes valid kind/duration/frequency/options/rationale. Planning does not collect. User POST /confirm permits original collection and at most one automatic verification, each <=60 seconds. Missing required collector-specific configuration may stop at manual_configuration_required.

Original collection/analysis success triggers diagnosis; viable plan triggers fresh verification task, analysis and re-diagnosis. Comparison checks kind/agent/full target identity/source/unit. Top self percentage changes are observations, not business latency or causal proof; repeated sampling root_cause_status remains not_tested.

propose_followup_collection returns only a proposed plan and requires_confirmation=true. At most two follow-up branch records per root investigation; each decision requires human confirmation, quota/authorization/source checks and audit. Accepted branches create independent collection and diagnosis records; not unconditional automatic supplement collection.

Source repair is admin-only and needs explicit consent. Enrolled manifest fixes project revision, readable/editable/frozen files, language/preset/commands/image ID. Linked live investigation additionally matches agent/PID/UID/start_time_ticks/source revision. Standalone enrolled projects without runtime binding cannot pretend to match a live target.

Only three model-visible repair tools: profile_business_flow returns actual cProfile hotspots and source lines/SHA on enrolled workload; read_source returns <=160 enrolled lines with SHA; test_patch uses <=6 edits with original SHA and unique nonoverlapping contexts. Runtime budget <=8 model rounds,12 tool calls,2 actual sandbox tests,420 seconds.

Go invokes type-bounded POST /rpc over executor UDS with action/project_id/source_revision/execution_id/arguments. Root broker owns enrolled source/image policy. Go API does not receive Docker socket or host source. Fresh container has network none, no credentials, UID10001, cap_drop ALL, no-new-privileges, read-only root,512MiB,1CPU,64 process,240s hard cap. These are separate from collector Agent namespaces.

manifest-python-v1 requires independent new unittest regressions on unchanged baseline and candidate: original must fail by assertion, candidate passes; syntax/import errors and skips do not count. Then original frozen checks and type/value/mutable-output parity, six alternating baseline/candidate CPU pairs and identical-frozen-baseline sham stability check. Original CRM/Saber presets retain their own prior regression/output/six-pair protocols; do not attribute new red-green/sham to every historical preset.

Go accepts only genuine successful/accepted test receipt and valid evidence IDs and source lines. Returned unified-diff patch_bundle includes source_revision/content/sha256/code_files/test_files/applied_to=isolated_snapshot/production_deployed=false. Browser verifies SHA before download. Human reviews, merges and deploys separately. CPU claims apply only to registered synthetic component benchmark, not whole production service P95/P99.
